# Getting help

- **Usage questions / unexpected results** — open a
  [GitHub issue](https://github.com/kollerma/jss-style-checker/issues).
  For a suspected false positive, include the violating line, the rule
  id from the report, and (if possible) a minimal `.tex`/`.bib` snippet
  that reproduces it — false-positive reports feed directly into the
  measured-precision evaluation loop (`eval/README.md`).
- **Security issues** — see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md); please
  report privately.
- **Contributing** — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the
  gate list and the requirements for new rules.
- **Rule reference** — `jss-lint explain <RULE-ID>` on the command
  line, or the full catalogue at
  [`specs/003-jss-rule-catalogue/catalogue.md`](../specs/003-jss-rule-catalogue/catalogue.md).

The project is maintained on a best-effort basis by a single
maintainer; expect an initial response within about a week. It is an
independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by the Journal of
Statistical Software.
